column1: # Differences between malt --preset all and MATLAB's checkcode with every check enabled, that are accepted.
# Read by tests/matlab_conformance_all.rs. Columns, tab-separated: path (relative to tests/fixtures, or *),
# line (or *), check ID, direction (malt-only: malt reports and MATLAB does not; matlab-only: the reverse),
# reason. A * path and line accepts every difference of that check and direction. An entry that matches
# no difference fails the test, so the list only shrinks. See docs/VERIFY.md, 'Preset all against MATLAB'.
